paragraphs: I keep my list short on purpose. Most weeks I see fewer than a dozen new patients, and every one of them gets a full hour with me, not a coordinator.
Some consults end with a plan. Some end with me suggesting you wait. Both are good outcomes, and you will never be charged for being told no.

cases.name: Upper eyelid lift
cases.meta: Patient, 52. Day surgery with local anesthetic and light sedation.

frames.caption: The sitting.
frames.detail: Marked, measured and photographed before surgery. Every later frame is compared to this one.

frames.caption: Swelling and stitches.
frames.detail: Bruising peaks around day three and stitches come out on day six. Most people work from home this week.

frames.caption: Back to routine.
frames.detail: Swelling is mostly gone and the scar sits in the natural crease. Light makeup and the gym are fine again.

frames.caption: Settled.
frames.detail: The final shape is visible. Scars keep fading for up to a year, and we photograph you again at month twelve.

cases.note: Shown with patient consent. Individual results vary.

cases.name: Rhinoplasty
cases.meta: Patient, 34. General anesthetic, one night’s stay.

frames.caption: The sitting.
frames.detail: Profile and front views, plus the breathing test we repeat at week 12.

frames.caption: Splint off.
frames.detail: The splint comes off on day seven. The nose looks wider than it will, which is normal.

frames.caption: Most swelling gone.
frames.detail: Glasses can rest on the nose again. The tip is still firm and a little full.

frames.caption: Nearly final.
frames.detail: Breathing is retested. The tip keeps refining slowly for about a year.

cases.note: Shown with patient consent. Individual results vary.

cases.name: Abdominoplasty
cases.meta: Patient, 41. General anesthetic, one night’s stay.

frames.caption: The sitting.
frames.detail: Standing photos in the same pose, with the planned scar line agreed and marked.

frames.caption: Walking, slightly bent.
frames.detail: Drains come out in the first week. A compression garment stays on day and night.

frames.caption: Standing tall.
frames.detail: Desk work is fine and the garment comes off. No lifting over 10 lb yet.

frames.caption: Back to everything.
frames.detail: Exercise is unrestricted. The scar is pink and will flatten over the next year.

procedures.name: Upper eyelid lift
procedures.summary: Removes heavy upper-lid skin so the eyes look rested, not changed.
procedures.suits: People whose upper lids feel heavy or crowd their lashes.

procedures.name: Rhinoplasty
procedures.summary: Refines the shape of the nose and can improve breathing in the same operation.
procedures.suits: Adults whose nose has finished growing and who want a refinement, not a new face.

procedures.name: Chin and jawline contouring
procedures.summary: Balances a soft chin or jawline with an implant or precise bone work.
procedures.suits: People whose profile feels unbalanced from the side.

procedures.name: Breast augmentation
procedures.summary: Adds volume with implants sized to your frame at the sitting.
procedures.suits: People who want fuller breasts and are ready for implant check-ins over the years.

procedures.name: Liposuction
procedures.summary: Removes stubborn fat from one or two areas that diet and exercise have not changed.
procedures.suits: People near their goal weight with good skin elasticity.

procedures.name: Abdominoplasty
procedures.summary: Removes loose skin and repairs separated muscles after pregnancy or weight loss.
procedures.suits: People who are done with pregnancies and stable in weight.

faq.question: Is the consult really camera-off?
faq.answer: Yes. Video consults are audio-only unless you turn your camera on, and in-person consults happen in a closed room with no recording.

faq.question: Who sees my photos?
faq.answer: Only Dr. Osman and your care nurse. Photos live in your medical record, never on personal phones, and appear on this site only with your written consent.

faq.question: How long is recovery, honestly?
faq.answer: It depends on the procedure. Every procedure page lists real downtime ranges, and your written plan breaks recovery down week by week.

faq.question: What does the consult cost?
faq.answer: The consult is $250 and is credited to your surgery if you go ahead within six months.

faq.question: Can I bring someone with me?
faq.answer: Yes. Many patients bring a partner or friend. Tell us when you book and we will plan a longer slot.

faq.question: Do you offer financing?
faq.answer: Yes, through two medical lenders. We share options after your written quote, never before the exam.
